title: Talk About Your Day

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构草稿；未启用，尚待独立语义与发音审核。

instructions: 先准备关键词，再尝试用自己的短句说；音频评测需要真实录音及服务结果。
prompt: Speak in short sentences, using 70–100 words. Say when you wake, name one thing you wear, and say what you do after class. Use at least six lesson words.
guidance: 先说 I wake at ...；再说 I put on ...；用 After class, I ... 说课后安排；最后说 lunch 或 dinner 的时间。可先分段练短句，再连起来录自己的话。
reference: My name is Nia. On class days, I wake at five. I get up and make my bed. I wash my face. Today I put on a blue shirt and my shoes. The sun is out, so I put a hat on my head. I start class at ten. I eat lunch at one. After class, I stay for five minutes to check a note. Then I take a slow walk. I eat dinner at six. Before dinner, I write a note for tomorrow.
referenceLabel: 原创 AI 示例，仅供学习。

oralModelAudio.text: My name is Nia. On class days, I wake at five. I get up and make my bed. I wash my face. Today I put on a blue shirt and my shoes. The sun is out, so I put a hat on my head. I start class at ten. I eat lunch at one. After class, I stay for five minutes to check a note.
Then I take a slow walk. I eat dinner at six. Before dinner, I write a note for tomorrow.
